description: The Open Standard for Generative UI
summary: The neat trick here is that you define a component library and it derives the system prompt for you, so the model's output is constrained to a typed vocabulary you control rather than free-form HTML soup — that's the same grounding discipline I apply in Proreerfolio, where a generated résumé has to map back to real portfolio artifacts instead of hallucinated claims. The streaming-first language being 67% shorter than JSON matters when you're routing many agent sessions through PenguPool and want structured UI back without bloating context on every turn. I appreciate that the core parser is framework-agnostic with zero React dependency, so it slots into whatever surface I'm already shipping without pulling in a second rendering stack.
